keyEvents.text: Goal! Fenerbahce 0, Liverpool 1. Trey Nyoni (Liverpool) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.
Archie Brown (Fenerbahce) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Fenerbahce 1, Liverpool 1. Mason Greenwood (Fenerbahce) from a free kick with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Fenerbahce. Vedat Muriqi replaces Romelu Lukaku.
Substitution, Liverpool. Florian Wirtz replaces Joe Gomez.
Substitution, Liverpool. Alexander Isak replaces Víctor Muñoz.
Substitution, Liverpool. Cody Gakpo replaces Rio Ngumoha.
Goal! Fenerbahce 1, Liverpool 2. Alexander Isak (Liverpool) header from very close range to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Cody Gakpo with a cross.
Goal! Fenerbahce 2, Liverpool 2. Archie Brown (Fenerbahce) left footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the bottom left corner following a corner.
Substitution, Fenerbahce. Kerem Aktürkoglu replaces Irfan Can Kahveci.
Substitution, Fenerbahce. Mert Müldür replaces Nélson Semedo.
Substitution, Liverpool. Milos Kerkez replaces Kostas Tsimikas.
Goal! Fenerbahce 3, Liverpool 2. Vedat Muriqi (Fenerbahce) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Archie Brown with a cross.
Substitution, Liverpool. Lewis Koumas replaces Trey Nyoni.
Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
